messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: GPU claim threshold breached in gcp-europe-east1. Autoscaler paused new instance provisioning due to soft limit hit. Queue depth increasing (avg 4200 pending requests / 60s). Routing fallback triggered for low-priority tenants. See /ops/alerts/1749812345
alex (sre-oncall): I'm on it. Can someone confirm if this is quota/provisioning or underlying node failures?
emily (eng-runtime): Preliminary: autoscaler returned HTTP 429 from GCP quota API when requesting GPUs. Error snippet: `Quota exceeded for resource 'NVIDIA_TESLA'` — no node terminations in last 5m.
raj (eng-platform): Confirmed from control plane: allocation requests are being denied at cloud provider level. We have not hit per-project hard cap, looks like region-wide quota exhaustion.
lucas (infra): GCP console shows GPU quota near 100% in europe-east1 for our org. There were large burst claims from a few Dedicated customers earlier (10:12-10:25 UTC), might have drained the pool.
maya (customer-success): Any immediate customer visible impact? Are requests failing or just queued?
emily (eng-runtime): Most requests are stuck in queue; we surface `429` only when autoscaler gives up after retry window. Estimated customer impact: ~4% latency spikes >5s for hosted API keys, 0.6% request errors so far. Low-priority tenants are already degraded via fallback.
ops-bot: Runbook step: notify cloud-quotas, attempt temporary quota increase, and reroute to eu-west3/uk-south as fallback. Commands available:
```
# check pending queue
curl -s https://internal/api/queues?region=europe-east1 | jq .pending
# attempt retry to autoscaler
POST /internal/autoscaler/retry?region=europe-east1
```
alex (sre-oncall): I'm going to force a soft-routing policy to shift new requests to eu-west3 and us-central while team requests quota bump. Emily, can you throttle batch sizes for heavy models to free GPU slots?
emily (eng-runtime): On it. Reducing max_batch_size for large-model routes to 8 -> should drop memory/GPU claim per worker by ~20%. Pushing patch now.
raj (eng-platform): Adding a routing rule: prefer region=eu-west3 for non-low-latency requests. Deploying rule change in 30s.
lucas (infra): Opening quota request with GCP support (case: 0123456789) and requesting emergency increase +200 GPUs in europe-east1. ETA unknown but flagged as critical. Also provisioning plan B: warm pool in eu-west3.
maya (customer-success): Preparing a proactive note for customers in affected region, target msg: "brief latency increases" and we are mitigating. Will hold until we see impact >5% sustained.
alex (sre-oncall): Patch deployed and routing rule live. Early signs: queue depth downward trend (4200 -> 2600). Sending handoff to tom in 40m. If queue stabilizes <500, we can reopen.
ops-bot: Metric snapshot:
- queue_pending: 4200 -> 2600 (-38%)
- errors_429: 0.6% -> 0.4%
- avg_latency_hosted: 210ms -> 380ms for heavy-models
Please confirm continued decrease.
tom (oncall-next-shift): I'll take over the bridge at 11:15 UTC, standby for handoff notes. If GCP denies emergency quota, plan to flip to degraded mode and communicate.
emily (eng-runtime): One more mitigation: enabling KV-prefix caching for repeat inference calls on heavy routes — should cut token generation compute by ~12%. Rolling now.
raj (eng-platform): Noted: need to follow up postmortem to see why Dedicated customer burst drained region quota. Adding a temporary limit on Dedicated burst to avoid region-wide starvation.
alex (sre-oncall): Good. Keep updates here. If quota increase arrives, we will scale warm pool and tear down routing change. Otherwise escalate to infra lead for cross-org quota advocacy. :thumbsup:
